# About Google

> About Google provides comprehensive information on Google's products, technology, company history, global operations, and corporate commitments.

This site serves as Google's official hub for company information, featuring core content about products like Gemini and Google Search, company philosophy and history, global office locations, and sustainability initiatives. The site includes localized versions in multiple languages reflecting Google's worldwide presence.

## Key Topics

- Google
- Gemini
- Google Search
- YouTube
- Google Cloud
- Gmail
- Google Workspace
- Google DeepMind
- Alphabet
- AI innovation
- Company history
- Global operations
- Sustainability
- Corporate responsibility
- Business model

## Company Overview & Core Information

- [About Google: Our products, technology and company information](https://about.google): Google homepage showcasing products, AI innovation, and company information.
- [About Google: History, office locations, commitments, initiatives](https://about.google/company-info): Google company overview with history, locations, and sustainability initiatives.
- [Google's products and services](https://about.google/products): Comprehensive catalog of Google products including Gemini, Search, and AI tools.

## Global Presence & Operations

- [Google around the globe](https://about.google/around-the-globe): Google's global presence and regional operations across multiple countries.
- [Browse a list of Google's office locations](https://about.google/company-info/locations): Directory of Google offices in nearly 60 countries worldwide.
- [Google for Korea](https://about.google/intl/ALL_kr/around-the-globe/local-info): Google's economic impact, AI innovation, and programs in Korea.
- [About Google in the Philippines](https://about.google/intl/ALL_ph/around-the-globe/local-info): Google's operations, AI initiatives, and career programs in Philippines.
- [About Google in Ukraine](https://about.google/intl/ALL_ua/around-the-globe/local-info): Google's initiatives, Gemini products, and AI training in Ukraine.

## Company Philosophy & Values

- [Google's 10 Core Principles (Japanese)](https://about.google/intl/ja_ALL/company-info/philosophy): Japanese localization of Google's 10 core principles and philosophy.
- [Ten Things We Know to Be True (Spanish)](https://about.google/intl/es_ALL/company-info/philosophy): Spanish version of Google's 10 founding principles and philosophy.
- [Our Values and Commitments (German)](https://about.google/intl/de_ALL/company-info/commitments): German localization of Google's corporate values and commitments.
- [Google's Values and Commitments (Traditional Chinese)](https://about.google/intl/zh-TW_ALL/company-info/commitments): Traditional Chinese localization of Google's values and commitments.
- [About Human Rights at Google](https://about.google/company-info/human-rights): Google's human rights commitments and compliance with international standards.

## International Localizations

- [How Google Works (Italian)](https://about.google/intl/it_ALL/company-info/how-our-business-works): Italian localization explaining Google's business model and revenue.
- [Google's Story and Evolution (Italian)](https://about.google/intl/it_ALL/company-info/our-story): Italian localization of Google's founding story and evolution.
- [Como o Google funciona (Portuguese)](https://about.google/intl/pt_ALL/company-info/how-our-business-works): Portuguese localization explaining Google's business operations.
- [Google's Story (Korean)](https://about.google/intl/ko_ALL/company-info/our-story): Korean localization of Google's founding story and historical growth.
- [Acerca de Google (Spanish)](https://about.google/intl/es_ALL/company-info): Spanish localization of Google company info, history, and commitments.

## Support & Contact

- [Google support: Contact information, product help, office locations](https://about.google/company-info/contact-google): Contact information and support resources for Google products and services.

## Optional Resources

- [Brand Resource Center](https://about.google/brand-resource-center): Google brand guidelines, logo usage, and licensing information.
